mechanics.claim: The shield increases based on the target's missing health, up to +60% at 60% missing health.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 60 for 7|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 60% '''missing''' health.''}}|health}}

mechanics.claim: Shen channels for 3 seconds before the shield is applied and he blinks to the ally.
mechanics.quote: channeling for 3 seconds and granting the target allied champion a shield for 5 seconds at the time of cast

mechanics.claim: The shield lasts 5 seconds from the time of cast.
mechanics.quote: granting the target allied champion a {{tip|shield}} for 5 seconds at the time of cast

mechanics.claim: Interrupting the channel does not remove the shield early once granted, but if the target dies the channel is canceled and the ability goes on full cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Interrupting ''Stand United's'' channel will not remove the shield prematurely.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, not on completion of the channel.
Casting immediately upon respawn desyncs the cooldown from ability haste and removes the AP scaling from the shield (bug).
mechanics.quote: casting ''Stand United'' immediately upon respawning will cause its cooldown to be unaffected by ability haste, and the shielding will not be increased by '''Shen's''' {{as|ability power}}, but will be increased by his {{as|'''bonus''' maximum health}}
